verdict.rationale: Workers' Agents SDK docs explicitly state you can 'connect chat, voice, email, Slack, and webhooks to a durable agent runtime,' and Cloudflare's event-subscriptions feature lets Workers consume structured platform events via a queue to build custom workflows/integrations — both point to webhook-style event subscription being supported on the platform. However, this is more about Workers-as-HTTP-endpoint receiving webhooks generically rather than a dedicated, well-documented webhook subscription API/feature with examples for AI-native agent use cases. Missing for 10: dedicated webhook subscription documentation/tutorial, concrete code examples of an agent registering for and consuming webhooks, and independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific capability.
